101-4875-7507-8043.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell for free using Vision this turn.
101-4875-7507-8043.description:
Cast Kindred Charge for free due to Vision, choosing a creature type granted by Conspiracy, creating a token copy of each creature you control with haste, and setting up a delayed exile trigger.
Put the copy of Vision whose ability has been used in your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Vampire Charmseeker token enters, it triggers, returning Kindred Charge from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

687-5004-8095--73.easyPrerequisites: The creature with persist or undying doesn't  have a -1/-1 or +1/+1 counter on it respective to its ability.
687-5004-8095--73.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Cathodion.
Cathodion triggers, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing your persist/undying creature.
The creature's persist/undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield with a vigilance counter and the appropriate choice of a +1/+1 or -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Hammerhead
Activate Tayam by paying {3}, removing  both counters from your persist/undying creature and one counter from another creature, causing yourself to mill three cards and return Cathodion from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

3951-4192-5703-8095.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block and kill Altaïr.
You have at least one legendary creature card exiled with a memory counter on it.
3951-4192-5703-8095.description:
Declare Altaïr as an attacker. Altaïr triggers, exiling Éomer from your graveyard with a memory counter on it, and then creating a tapped and attacking token copy of each card you own that is exiled with a memory counter on it.
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing another legendary creature token except Éomer.
When the creature dies, Éomer triggers, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat during each combat phase.

5078-6089-7692.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Shuri.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Skyswimmer Koi triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Skyswimmer Koi trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

2438-7084-7893.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters, Thranduil triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

2111-3698-6982.description:
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Wingrattle Scarecrow
When Wingrattle Scarecrow dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Wingrattle Scarecrow enters, Grinding Station and Stalwart Successor trigger.
Resolve the Grinding Station trigger, untapping it
Resolve the Stalwart Successor trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Wingrattle Scarecrow
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 1
Repeat.

215-3443-4927.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven creature cards in your graveyard.
215-3443-4927.description:
Activate Deathbloom Ritualist by tapping it, adding an amount of {B} or {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Deathbloom Ritualist from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Deathbloom Ritualist by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.
215-3443-4927.notes: Alternate the colors of mana you add each time. If you start adding {B}, you need {G} for Temur Sabertooth and {G} to cast Deathbloom Ritualist

1770-3821-6844.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
1770-3821-6844.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Spider-Man 2099 by paying its mana cost.
When Spider-Man 2099 enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any creature you control

392-3532-5078-7737.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Stark's Ingenuity triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature it's attached to
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Birgi triggers, adding {R}
Repeat.

1494-6822-7435-7720.description:
If you have six or more cards in hand, activate Hardened Academic by discarding a card.
Repeat step 1 until you have five or fewer cards in hand.
At the beginning of your end step, The Ten Rings triggers, causing you to draw cards until you have ten cards in your hand.
Lyla triggers for each card drawn, putting that many +1/+1 counters on Sage of Hours.
Activate Sage of Hours by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, causing you to take at least one extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

81-1394-2060-5147-7038.description:
Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

457-1329-4659-7340.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Sewer-veillance Cam from your graveyard by paying {U}.
When Sewer-veillance Cam enters, it triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Sewer-veillance Cam, adding {U}.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Sewer-veillance Cam.
Sewer-veillance Cam triggers, untapping a creature you control.
Repeat.
457-1329-4659-7340.notes: If you control an artifact creature, it can be untapped by the second Sewer-veillance Cam trigger, and then tapped via Urza to get infinite blue mana. Once you have infinite blue mana, you can either use it for Urza's second ability and/or to activate Sewer-veillance Cam's ability to draw cards.

2440-7108-7109-7297.description:
Cast Trusty Boomerang by paying {1}.
Sokka's second ability and each Ally you control's prowess ability trigger.
Resolve all prowess triggers, giving each Ally you control +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Sokka trigger, creating a 1/1 Ally creature token.
When the Ally enters, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Ally you control.
Activate Trusty Boomerang's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Ally token.
Activate the Ally token by paying {1} and tapping it, tapping a creature a returning Trusty Boomerang from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
2440-7108-7109-7297.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if you control another Ally.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with Mirror Room locked and Fractured Realm unlocked

3457-4742-5921-5970.description:
Activate Marina by tapping it, unlocking Mirror Room.
Mirror Room triggers twice due to Fractured Realm, creating two token copies of Seeker of Skybreak.
Activate one of the Seeker of Skybreak tokens by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Activate Marina by tapping it, locking Mirror Room.
Activate the other Seeker of Skybreak token by tapping it, untapping Marina.
Repeat.

1765-4050-5972.notablePrerequisites:
You control an Aura that is attached to another creature you control.
You control at least one additional creature beyond the creature that has the Aura attached.
1765-4050-5972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing another creature that has an Aura attached to it.
When the creature dies, Cass triggers, returning an Aura that was attached to the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to another creature you control.
When the Aura enters the battlefield, Chishiro triggers, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

1020-2866-4659-4985.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Scrap Trawler by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Jhoira's Familiar.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Scrap Trawler, adding {C}{C}.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying its mana cost, which is reduced by Jhoira's Familiar.
Repeat.

2203-2366-4068-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
2203-2366-4068-5702.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Mountain.
2203-2366-4068-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Vorinclex triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

2919-3490-5070-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2919-3490-5070-5231.description:
Gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Archangel of Thune trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

104-2741-3490-5231.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-2741-3490-5231.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Essence Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Cleric Class triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Cleric Class trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

1668-2034-4128-5963.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
1668-2034-4128-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Chainer's ability by discarding a card, allowing you to cast a creature spell from your graveyard this turn.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Marvin, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Marvin from your graveyard by paying {2}.
When Marvin enters the battlefield, Chainer triggers, giving Marvin haste until end of turn.
Activate Marvin using Loran's ability by tapping it, causing you and an opponent to draw a card.
Repeat.

1636-1824-6406.easyPrerequisites: You haven't completed, or are currently venturing in, Tomb of Annihilation.
1636-1824-6406.notablePrerequisites: You control enough creatures such that you can cast Acererak the Archlich between mana produced by those creatures and its convoke ability.
1636-1824-6406.description:
Cast Acererak the Archlich by tapping a number of creatures and paying {0}.
When Acererak the Archlich enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Acererak the Archlich trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand and causing you to venture into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.
1636-1824-6406.notes: You can tap creatures for mana instead if that's more advantageous, and use that mana when casting the creature.

11-5195-5487-6526.manaNeeded: {U}{R}{W} plus enough mana to cast the spell that creates a token copy
11-5195-5487-6526.description:
Cast Flamehold Grappler by paying {U}{R}{W}.
When Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Cast Molten Duplication by paying its mana cost, targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Molten Duplication, with the copy targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Molten Duplication, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast this turn.
Holding priority, activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {U}{U}.
Cast Narset's Reversal by paying {U}{U}, targeting Molten Duplication
Flamehold Grappler and Storm-Kiln Artist trigger.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Flamehold Grappler trigger, copying Narset's Reversal, with the copy targeting the original Narset's Reversal.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, returning the original Narset's Reversal to your hand and creating a copy of Narset's Reversal targeting Molten Duplication.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Narset's Reversal copy, returning Molten Duplication to your hand and creating a copy of Molten Duplication targeting Flamehold Grappler.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Molten Duplication copy, creating a token copy of Flamehold Grappler.
When the token Flamehold Grappler enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying the next spell you cast.
Activate up to four Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast Molten Duplication.
Repeat from step 3.

2811-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
2811-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Elas il-Kor's second ability triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Warren Soultrader trigger, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Elas il-Kor's first ability triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

1018-1809-1987-4276.notablePrerequisites: Lands you control can tap to produce at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
1018-1809-1987-4276.description:
Activate any number of lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}{U}{U}.
Cast Turnabout by paying {2}{U}{U}, untapping all lands you control.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Skullwinder and Returned Pastcaller.
When Skullwinder and Returned Pastcaller enter the battlefield, they trigger, returning Turnabout and Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1018-1809-1987-4276.notes: If lands you control can tap to produce at least {5}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana. You can then stop casting Turnabout and blink one other permanent using Ghostly Flicker. You may also tap artifacts and/or creatures instead for mana if desired.

526-1235-2781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1235-2781.description:
Cast Twinflame by paying {1}{R}, creating a token copy of Felidar Guardian.
When the Felidar Guardian token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Felidar Guardian token.
Repeat from step 2.

1020-1913-2034-3689.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Workshop Assistant, adding {C}{C}.
When Workshop Assistant dies, it triggers, returning Myr Retriever to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Necron Warrior, adding {C}{C}.
Cast Myr Retriever by paying {2}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Myr Retriever, adding {C}{C}.
When Myr Retriever dies, it triggers, returning Workshop Assistant to your hand from your graveyard.
Imotekh the Stormlord's first ability triggers, creating two 2/2 Necron Warrior artifact creature tokens.
Cast Workshop Assistant by paying {3}.
Repeat.

1456-2510-5078.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Repeat

565-1283-1434-2909.description:
Activate Chromatic Orrery's first ability by tapping it, adding {5}.
Cast Mind Games with buyback by paying {4}, targeting Chromatic Orrery.
Orvar's first ability triggers, creating a token copy of Chromatic Orrery.
Resolve Mind Games, returning it to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may instead activate the Chromatic Orrery tokens using their second abilities, or target any other permanent.

851-1339-3265-4871.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
851-1339-3265-4871.description:
Activate Dockside Chef by paying {1}{B} and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Dockside Chef ability, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens with flying and haste.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Repeat.

643-4218.description: Activate The World Tree's second ability by paying {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}, tapping and sacrificing it, causing you to search for all creatures in your library, as they are all Gods due to Maskwood Nexus and put them onto the battlefield.

1162-2037.notablePrerequisites:
Minsc & Boo has at least two loyalty counters.
Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
1162-2037.description:
Activate Minsc & Boo's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, sacrificing Angelic Enforcer and dealing damage equal to Angelic Enforcer's power to target opponent with a life total equal to or less than your life total.
The opponent loses the game due to having 0 or less life.

3590-4222-4474.notablePrerequisites:
Freed from the Real and Paradise Mantle attached to Warchanter Skald.
Warchanter Skald does not have summoning sickness.
3590-4222-4474.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a 2/1 Dwarf Berserker token.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

643-4242-4640-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Su-Chi.
Su-Chi and Oathkeeper triggers.
Resolve the Su-Chi trigger, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Oathkeeper trigger, returning Su-Chi to the battlefield.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to Su-Chi's power.
Equip Oathkeeper to Su-Chi by paying {2}.
Repeat.
